note: No row substitutes a fixture for governed content, a cached number for a computed one, or a local rehearsal for a deployment. Where the honest response is to stop, the row says stop.

scenarios.detection: an outbound request times out, or the operator is told in advance
scenarios.does_not_prove: anything about the correctness of what is displayed
scenarios.proves: that the demonstration does not depend on a network
scenarios.response: continue unchanged: the demonstration is specified to run offline and every asset is served locally
scenarios.title: The venue has no network

scenarios.does_not_prove: that a run seen by fewer people is a different run
scenarios.proves: nothing about the system either way
scenarios.response: continue on the operator's screen and read the steps aloud; the run is unchanged
scenarios.title: The projector or display fails

scenarios.does_not_prove: anything about the science; a stylesheet is not a finding
scenarios.proves: that the interface degrades without hiding anything
scenarios.response: continue: the content is the same and the interface says which assets are missing
scenarios.title: A stylesheet or font fails to load

scenarios.detection: readiness reports the database component blocking
scenarios.does_not_prove: that an assessment was computed; nothing was
scenarios.proves: that the system fails closed and names what is missing
scenarios.response: stop the affected step and show the readiness page naming the missing component. Do not display a previously computed result as though it were computed now
scenarios.title: The database is unavailable mid-run

scenarios.detection: the runtime returns an error or no daemon answers
scenarios.does_not_prove: that a local process is a deployment. LOCAL_STAGING_REHEARSAL is not staging and must never be presented as it
scenarios.proves: nothing; a failed start is a failed start
scenarios.response: stop. Announce that the deployed path is unavailable and do not substitute a local process while describing it as staging
scenarios.title: The container runtime will not start the image

scenarios.detection: the source registry reports zero approved sources, or the canonical dataset is not published
scenarios.does_not_prove: that the pipeline works on real data; it has not been asked to
scenarios.proves: that the system refuses to compute from unapproved content
scenarios.response: stop before the case selection step. State that the corpus is unapproved and that no governed result can be produced
scenarios.title: No approved dataset is available

scenarios.detection: the default registry reports zero executable rulesets
scenarios.does_not_prove: that any rule is correct; none has been approved to be wrong
scenarios.proves: that the engine refuses to run without governed rules
scenarios.response: stop before the assessment step and say that no approved rule exists to evaluate
scenarios.title: No executable ruleset is registered

scenarios.detection: the safety gate reports a failing invariant
scenarios.response: stop the entire demonstration immediately. A failing safety invariant is not a presentation problem
scenarios.title: A safety invariant fails during the run

scenarios.detection: the result is empty rather than absent
scenarios.does_not_prove: that the case has no pharmacogenomic implication
scenarios.proves: that missing data is not shown as low risk
scenarios.response: show the empty result with its coverage axis. An empty finding set with full coverage and an empty one with no coverage are different answers and the interface distinguishes them
scenarios.title: The assessment produces no findings

scenarios.detection: a spoken request during the demonstration
scenarios.does_not_prove: that the system could handle such a case safely if asked
scenarios.proves: that the boundary is structural rather than a policy somebody follows
scenarios.response: decline. The case model refuses real-patient, genotype and raw sequencing fields at any depth, and no such ingestion exists
scenarios.title: The audience asks for a real patient case

scenarios.detection: a spoken question during the demonstration
scenarios.does_not_prove: any softened version of the answer. There is no partial clinical validation here to describe
scenarios.proves: nothing; it is an answer, not a result
scenarios.response: answer that none has been performed, without qualification, and name what is missing: zero validation cases, no holdout set, no computed metric, no completed expert review
scenarios.title: The audience asks about clinical validation

scenarios.detection: the named reviewer does not attend
scenarios.does_not_prove: that a review would have happened but for the absence
scenarios.response: state that no expert review has been completed at all, which is the standing position and not a consequence of their absence
scenarios.title: The expert reviewer is unavailable

scenarios.does_not_prove: that the underlying evidence was ever different from what the failure says
scenarios.response: stop and show the failure. Do not rebuild the pack during the demonstration to make the check pass
scenarios.title: The evidence pack fails its own integrity check

scenarios.detection: a gate reports PASS where the recorded state is BLOCKED
scenarios.does_not_prove: that the programme advanced. An unexplained PASS is the most likely shape of a bug in this software
scenarios.proves: nothing until the disagreement is resolved
scenarios.response: stop and treat it as a defect in the pack, not as good news. Re-run the gate from source artifacts and compare
scenarios.title: A gate appears to pass unexpectedly
